new_findings.title: isSamePostedSession reads peekSession() (localStorage first). persist=session tab (u-1/r1 in sessionStorage) with a hung POST; another tab signs in u-2 with persist=local; abort at 120 s -> guard sees u-2 and does not clear, so the tab-local u-1/r1 copy survives; when u-2 later signs out (other tab), the next request in this tab POSTs r1 AGAIN (posts ["r1","r1"])
new_findings.evidence: after abort: {"a":"A:AUTH_REQUIRED","token":"acc-u2","refresh":"r-u2","user":"u-2","sToken":"old","sRefresh":"r1","posts":["r1"]}; after localStorage.clear() + new request + 121 s: {"b":"B:AUTH_REQUIRED","sToken":null,"sRefresh":null,"posts":["r1","r1"]}. Needs mixed persist + 120 s hang + other-user logout, hence minor; consequence server-side is reuse detection revoking the family (self-healing) rather than a session leak.
new_findings.repro: installLocks(fakeLocks()); const { calls } = installFetch(c => c.path==="/api/v1/auth/refresh" ? hangUntilAborted(c.init) : problem(401,"/problems/token-expired")); seedUser("u-1","old","r1",sessionStorage); const A=await newTab(); const a=outcome("A",A.api.apiFetch("/v1/orders/a")); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60_000); seedUser("u-2","acc-u2","r-u2",localStorage); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(61_000); await a; localStorage.clear(); const b=outcome("B",A.api.apiFetch("/v1/orders/b")); await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(121_000); await b; expect(posts(calls)).toEqual(["r1"]); // FAILS: ["r1","r1"]

F-2: same user with refresh token removed (old or new access) -> AUTH_REQUIRED and the broken session IS cleared, 0 POST; other user without refresh token -> AUTH_REQUIRED, u-2 intact, 0 POST, both via lock wait and via the no-locks direct path; signed out while waiting -> AUTH_REQUIRED, 0 POST, epoch +1 (pre-existing, harmless). F-5/isSamePostedSession: other user WITHOUT refresh token during the POST (abort and 401) -> u-2 intact, 1 POST; same user with refresh token removed during the POST -> not cleared at abort, next call clears cleanly with no second POST of r1; same user/same pair untouched -> abort clears (AUTH_REQUIRED, storage empty); empty user id both sides -> cleared ('' === ''). F-1: network error with an order on screen keeps polling (7 GETs / 30 s) with spinner + manual button (designed); without an order NOT_FOUND / network / AUTH_REQUIRED keep their cards; forbidden card has no retry/manual button and the 'Tom tat thanh toan' summary (tier/total) still renders under it (harmless).
